description: Find LLM API models by name, developer, minimum Intelligence Index score or maximum input price. Each result shows the cheapest standard price per 1M tokens, the seller, the number of sellers and the easiapiai.com page. Use sort='price' with min_score to find the cheapest model that is good enough.

max_input_price.description: Maximum input price in USD per 1M tokens at the cheapest seller.

min_score.description: Minimum Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (0-100; frontier models score 50+).

query.description: Part of a model name, e.g. 'claude', 'gpt-6', 'deepseek flash'.

sort.description: Default: relevance with a query, score without.

name: search_models
title: Search LLM API models
